Overview About the Role - We are seeking a highly motivated program manager who is also a hands-on data analyst to operate the Quality Assurance program for Instacart’s global Customer Experience organization. You will own the operating rhythm of the QA program — cadences, service-level agreements, and cross-functional commitments — and you will personally build the dashboards, reporting, and analyses that turn raw audit data into insight the business acts on. The Senior Program Manager will work closely with Performance Management, Learning & Development, Automation Engineering, Operations, Policy, Product, and the broader Analytics organization at Instacart. a16z-saronic-technologies:ashbyhq:e4bd92.description: Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms. Job Overview Saronic Technologies is looking to hire a CAD Librarian to help with both their electrical and mechanical engineering teams. The company is scaling rapidly across engineering, manufacturing, and software, and this role sits at the intersection of electrical and mechanical design data — keeping the component libraries that Saronic engineers depend on accurate, complete, and current. The CAD Librarian is responsible for interpreting component data sheets submitted by engineers and accurately entering part data, attributes, and metadata into Saronic ECAD and MCAD environments. This is a detail-oriented, process-driven role that supports both the electrical and mechanical engineering teams. The CAD Admin will define the standards and workflows the Librarian follows via documented processes — this person’s job is to execute those processes with precision and ownership. Day-to-day responsibilities include receiving component requests from engineers, locating and interpreting the associated data sheets, and ensuring all relevant attributes are correctly entered into the appropriate tool. For electrical components this includes ratings, voltage ranges, connector types, associated backshells, Inserted terminals, crimping info for manufacturing and other components attributes and footprints,. For mechanical components this includes dimensions, material properties, thread specifications, and tolerancing. The Librarian will also field follow-up questions from engineers when data sheet information is unclear or inconsistent, and flag discrepancies for resolution. This person will work closely with the ECAD Administrator and MCAD Administrator and will be expected to maintain consistent, auditable records of all library additions and modifications. Qualifications - Associate’s degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience in drafting, electrical design, or engineering support. - 2+ years of experience as a drafter, designer, or in a CAD support role. - Hands-on experience with at least one CAD tool — electrical or mechanical. - Ability to read and interpret component data sheets. - Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. - Austin, TX on-site required. ADDITIONAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS This is primarily an attitude and work ethic hire at the base qualification level. Candidates who demonstrate genuine ownership of their work, curiosity about the tools and components they’re working with, and a willingness to fully commit to the librarian function — rather than treating it as a steppingstone — are the target profile. Growth path from this role is into a draftsman position, electrical or mechanical, as the company scales. albumvc-filevine:lever:f34f82e0-b7a4-414.description: Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. uppartners-hermeus:lever:57d829db-bdf9-4.title: Senior Avionics Manufacturing Engineer
uppartners-hermeus:lever:57d829db-bdf9-4.description: Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage. The Manufacturing Team at Hermeus are the boots on the ground. We have a vast array of experiences ranging from welding, additive, tube bending, machining, integration, and avionics. We are a lean team who are responsible for building a vehicle that will fly. We provide crucial design feedback to our engineering team and can rapidly iterate on design and assembly.
responsibilities: You will lead improvement projects to ensure that safety, reliability, and process capability goals are achieved, maintained, and improved
You will be a vital part of the relationship between our engineering and technician team
You will provide input into the design and development of new and existing hardware and take a lead role in the manufacturing and integration of our current and next-generation vehicles
You will drive root-cause analysis and corrective action recommendations/implementation

You will apply process improvement methodologies and tools (e.g. value stream mapping, problem-solving, visual management, etc.) to reduce manufacturing build hours and quality issues; increase production rates; and remove waste from complex processes
You will manage projects and execute to tight timelines while effectively communicating with and influencing stakeholders

You will train technicians, engineers, and leaders on best-in-class operations practices by leading process improvement workshops; providing training and information briefs on key topics; and personally, demonstrating by implementing solutions in the area
You will work with design engineers to evaluate designs for manufacturability and test requirements, then implement in a rapidly evolving production environment
You will ideate and implement tooling and test solutions, enabling high-quality hardware
You will be responsible for the manufacturability and introduction into the rate manufacturing environment of assigned products
You will contribute to design reviews acting as an expert in design for manufacturability, design for testability, yield improvements, supplier capabilities assessments, quality control, etc
You will be the primary point of contact for the production of non-conforming products, troubleshooting, root cause, failure investigations, and corrective actions
You will work on process and tooling development/validation for new products
You will drive the optimization of assembly and test procedures

You will prepare engineering documentation necessary for the transition from development to production including assembly procedures, test procedures, standard operating procedures, schematic diagrams, bills of materials, suitable alternate parts lists, and mechanical drawings
You will lead continuous improvement efforts of established product

5+ years of experience in design and or production of electronics hardware systems
Experience with electro-mechanical assembly and subassemblies
Experience with end to end printed circuit board fabrication
Experience with high power electronics and/or motor drivers
Demonstrated professional experience providing engineering and manufacturing support for the production of highly complex electronic products
Experience transitioning products from design to manufacturing as part of a cross-functional team
Hands-on experience with passion for continuous improvement and building the best hardware
Experience implementing design for manufacturing and design for test feedback
Strong communication skills and ability to read and provide feedback on technical documents
Ability to work overtime and weekends as needed
Capable of solving complex problems with little to no supervision on schedule as an individual or as a member of an integrated team
Ability to make appropriate assumptions and perform trade studies using first principles and engineering fundamentals to create rationale for clear recommendations
Demonstrated experience with CAD and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T)
Experience in control and monitoring of complex automated systems and risk assessment/reduction of the system
Knowledge of ERP systems, work order creation/management and BOM structures
Experience working in a flight, aviation, aerospace development program
Experience transitioning parts from first article to production

verdane-voyado:teamtailor:93dff85a-50ca-.description: We’re super excited to welcome our next teammate to our global Sales development team, focusing on the UK region. This is not your typical high-volume sales development role. At Voyado, we work within a clearly defined niche - retail and e-commerce, and that changes everything! Instead of calling 100 random companies a day, you’ll deep-dive into a carefully selected group of brands, truly understand their business, and craft creative, thoughtful ways to connect with them. If you’re curious about how e-commerce brands grow, love investigating companies and decision-makers, and enjoy combining strategy with creativity in your outreach, we’d love to hear from you! You’ll be part of our Global Sales Development team and work closely with Sales, Marketing and Partner Managers to strategically expand our footprint in the region. You’ll become an expert in: The retail and e-commerce landscape in the UK The systems brands use (e.g. e-com platforms, CRM, loyalty tools) Their growth ambitions and operational challenges The people behind the brands - from CRM Managers to CMOs This role is part research, part strategy, part creativity, and part relationship-building. You'll become a true Voyado ambassador, often the first point of contact for new prospects and the one selling a vision, not a product. Who are you? You’re curious by nature. When you discover a new brand, you want to understand how they grow, who they target, and what systems they use. We are looking for a collaborative and motivated individual who enjoys building relationships and is excited about creating value through sales. We believe that you are all about providing a world-class customer experience and thrive in a fast-paced environment. In either way, you're a natural connector, a true team-player, eager to develop yourself in SaaS sales. At the same ‚time you're results driven and are motivated by working towards set up targets with a winning mentality. You probably: Enjoy researching companies and connecting dots Like writing and tailoring messages rather than sending templates Thrive when you can combine structure with creativity Are energized by building something in a focused market You’re a natural connector, a team player, and genuinely interested in retail, e-commerce and tech.
